capabilities: Find unlinked notes, attachments, and Canvas files across the vault
Detect empty folders and empty folder trees
Report link coverage, unlinked size, and rankings by folder, category, and extension
Append links from a chosen note to reconnect unlinked files
Scope scans with paths, globs, and file-type or extension filters
extras: Scanning is read-only; the only note modification is appending a link the user explicitly confirms. Runs entirely locally with no network requests or telemetry. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer.
motivation: The author wanted to find the quiet corners of a vault and reconnect useful material without deleting or moving anything.
problem: Obsidian does not offer a built-in vault-wide report of files with no incoming links or of empty folders, so useful material can sit forgotten and disconnected.
summary: Vault scanner that reports unlinked notes and attachments, empty folders, and link-coverage statistics, and helps reconnect files into notes.
